data.title: Bool doors
data.statement:
You want to enter as far as possible in a house.
But there is an alarm system.

You can go through a door only if it is {{unlocked}}, (mainwhile the alarm is {{on}})
If the door's alarm is {{off}}, you can keep going.  
If the door's alarm is {{on}}, you'll be stopped and cannot go through the next door.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You want to enter as far as possible in a house.
But there is an alarm system.

You can go through a door only if it is unlocked, (mainwhile the alarm is on)
If the door's alarm is off, you can keep going.
If the door's alarm is on, you'll be stopped and cannot go through the next door.
Input
Line 1 : An integer nd for the number of doors
nd next lines : A string with the state of each door (locked or unlocked) and the state of each door's alarm (on or off), separated by a space
Output
Line 1 : An integer indicating the number of doors you can pass.
The doors are given in the order in which you encounter them
Constraints
1 ≤ nd ≤ 20
Example
Input
1
unlocked off
Output
1
